title: Work IQ: agents select the most relevant skills for each request
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, licensing rules and package controls are supported. No documentation found establishes the dynamic-selection feature's default, specific controls or separate meter; the briefing appropriately states those gaps. The related business-skills description should flag its documented preview status.

claims.claim: The licensing model is mixed, combining Microsoft 365 Copilot entitlement with usage-based billing.
claims.quote: For Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users, Work IQ is available in all Microsoft 365 Copilot experiences and agents. It is subject to usage-based billing for custom and third-party agents. Users without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license are billed based on usage.

claims.claim: The beta Update package operation can update allowedUsersAndGroups for user availability.
